name: St Paul's Physio
notes: City-centre clinic, works with BUPA and insurers, no GP referral needed. Chartered team with elite sport background - credible video stories.

name: Backcare & Acupuncture Clinic
notes: Open 6 days including Saturdays, publishes mobile 07810 770347 too. Combines physio, osteopathy and sports massage.

name: Birmingham Physiocare
notes: Personalised physio care, weekday hours plus weekend on-call. Small independent - decision maker answers the phone.

name: Bristol Osteopaths
address: 253 Wells Road, Knowle, Bristol (plus Queen Charlotte St, Sneyd Park, Saltford)
notes: Five sites, each with its own email and phone - pick the biggest (Queen Charlotte Street 0117 922 7788) first. Multi-location = repeated video needs.

name: Birdwell Osteopathic Practice
address: Birdwell Clinic, 33 Weston Road, Long Ashton, Bristol
notes: Full disabled access and home visits, open 9-7 weekdays. Long-established local practice. CAUTION: listed phone is also shown as a fax number elsewhere - confirm on first call.

name: South Street Park Osteopathy
notes: Solo practitioner (Barbara), appointments by arrangement, home visits offered. Appointments-by-arrangement model means marketing matters.

name: Brookhouse Hypnotherapy Manchester
notes: Site explicitly labels 07498 210342 as Text/WhatsApp, with landline 0161 881 1677. Trading since 1989 - strong authority story, offes a no-obligation consultation.

name: Nutritional Family Nutrition Clinic
notes: Specialist dietetic practice for eating disorders, ADHD, autism and ARFID. Lists WhatsApp alongside phone. Sensitive area - content must be handled carefully.

name: London Dietitian (Claudia Ehrlicher)
address: London-brand practice, online UK-wide and Eastbourne
notes: 25+ years experience, formerly Harley Street and Little Venice. Now online-first - personal brand video translates directly to bookings.

name: The London Clinic of Nutrition
notes: Marylebone clinic, Mon-Fri 9-5:30. Email obfuscated on the directory - capture from the website or by phone.

name: Raquel Britzke Nutrition
notes: Wimpole Street clinic, open Mon-Sat including Saturdays. Email obfuscated on the listing.

name: CrossFit Clifton
notes: CrossFit affiliate in Clifton. Also trades as PR Fitness Bristol. Community-led gym - member stories are the format.

name: CrossFit Greater Brislington
address: Unit 12, Dixon Business Centre, Dixon Road, Brislington, Bristol
notes: 14 years affiliated with a named head coach (Angelo Flammia). Independent and community-driven.

name: CrossFit Fort Ashton
notes: Largest-looking Bristol affiliate listing. Directory only - email and website need confirming in the first call.

name: FPS Fitness
notes: Pole, aerial and circus fitness with hen parties and studio hire. Extremely visual discipline. Email-only contact.

name: SOTE Studios
address: Units 5-6 Progress Works, Allcock Street, Digbeth, Birmingham
notes: Four studios in Digbeth housing a musical theatre school plus dance and fitness classes. Showcase and cast content is a natural fit.
